opportunities.name: Paper lookup: arXiv advanced search → Semantic Scholar → note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a specific year, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citations, and save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Search > Advanced search
Type the topic in the search term box
Tick the date checkbox, select specific year, enter the year
Click Search and open the first result
Copy the paper title
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the result
Read first author and citation count
Add a note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations'

opportunities.name: Case law lookup: CourtListener → Cornell LII statute → note
opportunities.description: Search a Supreme Court case on CourtListener, open it, look up the related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: Open CourtListener Case Law search
Enter the case name in the keyword box and press Enter
Open the matching case result
Read citation and decision date
Search the related statute on Cornell LII and open the section
Add a note: '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)'

steps: Click the activity combobox, select all, type the activity
